initial_admission_stop.reason: An archive row reported original-decision inconclusive and effective current status unassessed. Initial readout stopped before fitting or any inference.
initial_admission_stop.result: Read the effective current decision. Unassessed inputs continue to provide no score.

method.advance: Both selection and confirmation need at least four net extra strong-speech detections against current, at least two more than score-only, no additional false AI in either strong-speech cell, no additional clean false AI, no lost clean synthetic AI flags, and recoveries from two synthetic generator families.
method.correction: Fit one label-free linear correction on paired changes of the same foreground in competing speech.
method.fit_loss: Clean correction squared plus four times residual paired score drift squared plus trace-scaled ridge.
method.point: One score per method. Enforce the incumbent false AI count in each calibration condition using strict excess.
method.policy: Existing original and unassessed outcomes are retained. Other outcomes are AI when the score exceeds the point.
method.readout: Current raw log odds minus the correction centered on the fitted clean embedding mean.
method.scope: Use only original pooled features and incumbent raw responses. No acoustic condition or second file at prediction.
method.weights: Equal fitted clean foregrounds. Equal noisy variants within each paired foreground.

native_frozen_sources.frozen_decision: Existing original and unassessed outcomes are retained. Other outcomes are AI when the score exceeds the point.
native_frozen_sources.point_source: Existing four-second calibration points with no native refit

scope: Controlled four-second speech mixtures plus independently qualified three-second native AMI mixtures. Correlated views share foregrounds and rooms. No serving change.
